newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker prices stable, direction sought.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker prices stable, direction sought.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were little changed from Friday as players were cautious amid thin talk, traders said on Monday.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $102 and 380-cst at $108 a tonne. Traders said most players were mixed on near term price direction after the recent plunge in cargo prices.
"We will wait and see and see how the cargo market performs," said a seller
"Enquiries were very thin on a typical Monday," said another trader. MDO and gas oil prices were stable at $193-$200 and $205-$225. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3086)
